text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and I are heading back to
the
academy. The sun starts to set as the
dorm curfew
draws nearer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No! Sweet mother of mercy!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To have forgotten something so vital...
This is
most unbecoming of the
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've forgotten an essential piece of the
living
masterpiece that is I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't purchase rose petals to set afloat
in the
bathtub!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: NO! With every ounce of my being, no!
choice_data_list: ……門限も近いし、今日は諦めたら？

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What unforgivable folly it would be to

deliberately neglect my radiant shine!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that you understand the direness of
my
predicament, you can accompany me
to purchase
said roses.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Think of those precious petals, earnestly
waiting
to share a frolicking moment
with me in the
tub—now wallowing in the
despair that I have yet
to claim them.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I must go this instant and rescue them
from their
anguish!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Make haste!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Make haste!
choice_data_list: ああ、急いで買いにいこう！
うん、急いで買いにいこう！
いや、君のためにも門限は守ろう
いや、貴方のためにも門限は守ろう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make her promise she'll return to the
academy
by curfew, and we head to her
usual shop.
choice_data_list: ああ、急いで買いにいこう！
うん、急いで買いにいこう！
いや、君のためにも門限は守ろう
いや、貴方のためにも門限は守ろう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Five minutes before curfew... And the
roses are
safely in my loving embrace.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! The Overlord keeps her word!
Have I
inspired you once more?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That I am as great and beautiful as I am
noble?
Mediocre! Those traits should be
more than
obvious to you by this point!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes! I should offer my thanks for

accompanying me. Here, a rose for you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Were you aware, Trainer? Roses carry
with them
two special meanings...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Keep heart and "you shall return with
hope."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you agree those words
perfectly
describe us this night?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You don't seem so sure. I was
certain that
revelation would have you in
tears...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Are you implying what I believe
you are?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are already content, because the
hope
you've gained is no other than I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Touché, Trainer! You got me that time!
Haaah ha
ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With T.M. Opera O in high spirits, I see
her off
and return home.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that no amount of roses will
ever make
up for a lack of beauty sleep.
choice_data_list: 門限を破ると夜遅くまで説教コースだぞ
門限を破ると夜遅くまで説教コースだよ

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is terrible!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas, I had forgotten something so basic!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Limbs with the sheen of icefish! Skin soft
as silk!
The beautiful and handsome
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All of that preserved through leading a
proper
lifestyle, and yet, here I am...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer, for reminding me of
this very
important truth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My heart aches for those poor roses
who, alas,
must be left to wait in vain.
They shall receive my
full affection
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight will be a night to turn in early.
That goes
for you as well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Take this advice from me, as an

expression of my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For I shall meet you in your dreams,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And we will have a dance party, in the
rose-filled
courtyard of a beautiful
castle beneath the stars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the elaborate scene she's
described.
Some interesting dreams are
bound to visit me
tonight.
